about: The Nov 4 blind set (Track S's sealed_8), Wed Nov 4 2026: a fresh Claude Sonnet writer who never opened the repo wrote 39 scam notes of any kind, 20 plainly worded ones and 30 fair notes. Scored on the rules alone, with no AI, on the rules as merged at dc886ce6, once, before anything was tuned on it. This file is that result, kept as it was: 21 of 59 scam notes clear, 29 hold, 9 refuse; 30 fair notes 21 clear, 9 hold, 0 refuse. Then, the same day, the AI reader's first and only run on it, also before any tuning: 0 of 59 scam notes clear, 24 hold, 35 refuse; 30 fair notes 15 clear, 11 hold, 4 refuse. Re-scored note by note on 874ea170 with the same verdicts. A later rule change does not change this record: a first run happens once. One writer, one set: a bounded test, not a rate, and now that it is in the repo it is used up as a blind set.
withReader: claude-haiku-5-5 with a 3 second limit, on the rules at 874ea170, Wed Nov 4 2026: Track S's first and only run, 89 of 89 calls answered, no tuning. Each row's withReader is its final verdict. A later fix gets its own label; it does not change this record.
